Goal
* Please change "[[.]]" to "{{.}}".

* Please change "(Note:" to "Note:".

* Please change "[[1]])" to "{{1}}."

Input
* Please add a description of [[S]].

Output
* Please change "[[Result S]" to "The resulting string after modifying [[S]]".

Constraints
* Please change "[[Length of S]]" to "length of [[S]]".

Game modes
* Consider enabling Reverse mode.

Cases
* Please remove the trailing newline from the input for:
  • samp_01 (Test 1)

* Please remove the trailing newline from the output for:
  • samp_02 (Test 2)

* The case names don't meaningful describe the cases. Please change them back to Test 1, Validator 1, and so on.

* The current cases are well ordered in that their lengths increase from shortest to longest, providing a good progression.

* However, all cases except Test 1 use strings whose letters are in alphabetical order. As a result, the same letters (b, d, f and so on) are consistently replaced with "." while others (a, c, e and so on) are not. In addition, all-caps strings are featured only in the validators. Consequently, the test cases provide insufficient coverage of different letter cases and character patterns, making it difficult to verify that the solution handles arbitrary input strings correctly.

* Please rewrite all cases except Test 1 so that the input strings are not simply in alphabetical order. Use either real words or completely randomly ordered letters. Please ensure that the full alphabet is represented in both lowercase and uppercase, separately for tests and validators.

* Please also satisfy the following conditions:
  • Don't leave any trailing newlines in the inputs or outputs.

  • Validator 1: [[S]] has an odd length between 3 and 9 (inclusive), and uses a mix of lowercase and uppercase letters.

  • Test 2 and Validator 2: [[S]] has length 1, and uses uppercase letters only.

  • Test 3 and Validator 3: [[S]] has even length of around 20, and uses lowercase letters only.

  • Test 4 and Validator 4: [[S]] has odd length of around 50, and uses uppercase letters only.

  • Test 5 and Validator 5: [[S]] has even length of around 100, and uses a mix of lowercase and uppercase letters.

Thanks.
